scope: Actual Home Assistant notice and spinner modules, plus the official compiled empty state. Fictional household content; no Home Assistant account or API.
harness: Expose only the original module loader, use recorded theme/font inputs, and capture two independently identical PNGs per state and platform. The original spinner animation is stopped in the reference fixture to compare static paint.
